g.text: Where does the weaker 2023 summer transport come from?
JAS contrasts: 2023 minus each control | SODA3.15.2 | All 1982–2024 years define the background
The two diagnostics have different domains. Signed contributions are kinematic decompositions, not causal effects.
The 2023 advection sign depends on background treatment; the lower-than-both-controls ordering is robust.
